label: Heavy going
summary: 42 — the Iran war moves from missiles to money. Trump declared the 'most crushing economic operation' ever against Tehran and threatened 'economic D-Day' for any country that keeps trading with it; Iranian state media called the claim delusional. Brent held near $92. Russian ballistic missiles hit at least three Kyiv districts, killing six, as Zelenskyy faces pressure at home over elections. Seoul woke to a scaled-back US drill order and open doubt about a 72-year alliance. In the Central African Republic more than 100 are dead after tunnels collapsed at an artisanal gold mine near Zamboye. The lift came from the lab: a personalised mRNA therapy passed a phase 3 melanoma trial for the first time. White storks are nesting in the English Midlands after 600 years. Formula score, no editorial adjustment.
